summary: Iter13 — Phase A/B/C Engagements + tier restructure + reminders badge + Settings z-index fix. Backend pytest 12/12 PASS (reminders/badge 200 with {count}, firm/subscribe rejects 'verified'/'enterprise' with 400, accepts featured/premium/practice; engagement creation gates: free=402, featured=402, premium=200 with limit=25; invite locked-to-email rejects wrong client with 403). Reference test_engagements.py 18/18 PASS end-to-end (firm signup -> tier bump -> invite -> accept -> messages encrypted -> file upload/download decrypts -> Lex draft+summary -> close-engagement blocks further messages). Frontend smoke (390x844): BottomNav renders all 5 items (Home/Vault/LEX/Lawyers/Cases); EngagementsModal opens from tile-engagements, lists 4 existing engagements, thread view opens with Lex Draft / Summary buttons + file 📎 + 'Type a message...' input; FirmPortal /firm-portal renders FirmAuth with Sign in / Register firm tabs; firm signup succeeds and FirmDashboard mounts; BillingModal via firm-billing-btn shows all 3 tiers £49/£199/£399 with correct labels. Settings z-index fix VERIFIED — legal-tos-modal, legal-privacy-modal, manage-data-modal all open on top of the Settings modal correctly (the bug from this session is fixed).

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed bottom-nav (~60px) covers the last visible row of tiles. tile-engagements bounding box at y=790 height=130 — bottom of tile (920) extends below viewport AND its visible portion is partially under the fixed bottom-nav, so direct taps land on the bottom-nav buttons (home/vault/lex/lawyers/cases). Confirmed by repro: tile.click(force=true) at default scroll position did NOT open EngagementsModal; after page.evaluate('window.scrollBy(0,400)') and JS .click(), modal opens cleanly. Real users will tap-and-miss for any tile that lands at the bottom of the grid (currently 🤝 My Solicitor sits in that zone on iPhone-class viewports). Fix: add bottom padding/margin to the dashboard tile grid container equal to nav height + safe-area inset (e.g. paddingBottom: 'calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))').

action_items: [MEDIUM] Dashboard tile grid needs bottom padding to clear the fixed BottomNav on small viewports — currently the last row tiles (tile-engagements / tile-cases / tile-immigration) get partially obscured and their tap targets are intercepted by nav buttons. Add `paddingBottom: 'calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))'` (or equivalent) to the tile grid container in Dashboard.

[INFO] All other features in scope verified — engagements full lifecycle (invite/accept/messages/files/Lex/close), tier 402 gates, plan validation (featured/premium/practice), reminders/badge endpoint, firm portal auth + dashboard + billing modal, legal/privacy/manage-data modals (z-index fix verified).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4406 lines — long overdue for splitting (suggest: engagements_router.py, firm_router.py, reminders_router.py, contracts_router.py).
Engagement testids on consumer side use raw UUID suffix (engagement-<uuid>) — testable but verbose; consider adding an index-based testid alias for E2E tests (e.g. engagement-row-0).

/api/firm/engagements does not return a 'tier' field in the list response — frontend currently has to infer tier from a separate call. Adding `tier` and `engagement_limit` to GET /api/firm/engagements would let FirmDashboard render the quota meter without a second roundtrip.
EngagementCreate doesn't validate that client_email differs from the firm's own contact email — a firm could 'invite itself' creating a self-engagement. Add a guard.

FIRM_ENGAGEMENT_LIMITS['featured']=0 means a featured-tier firm appears in the directory but cannot start engagements. Make this UX-visible: on the firm dashboard show 'Engagements: not included in Featured — upgrade to Premium' instead of silently 402'ing on Invite click.

rca of the issue: ISSUE (tile-engagements click did not open modal on first attempt) — RCA: Mobile 390x844 viewport renders Dashboard tile grid that extends below the visible area. The BottomNav (position:fixed, bottom:0, ~60px tall) overlays the last row of tiles. The tile-engagements bounding box was {y:790, height:130}; bottom-nav z-index is higher than tile, so synthetic clicks via Playwright's `click(force=true)` at the tile centre actually land on the nav button (nav-lex/nav-lawyers — the gold avatar in the middle). Two fixes available: (1) DEV: add `paddingBottom: calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))` to the tile grid container so all tiles clear the nav; (2) TEST workaround: scroll the page so the tile is in the upper half of the viewport (or use a JS .click() which doesn't simulate pointer geometry). Functional code is correct — setModal({type: 'engagements'}) -> EngagementsModal renders with all expected children. The reference test_engagements.py confirms the full backend round-trip works.
